If sentiment is positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to align with upward momentum decay.

If sentiment is negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract downward bias.

If sentiment is neutral (0.00–0.33) and true price spikes >1.5% from prior 7-day avg, add 1–2% upward correction to late horizon (16–30 days) to capture breakout momentum.

If sentiment swings from positive to negative within last 5 days, reduce forecast slope by 0.3–0.7% per day for early horizon to reflect sentiment reversal.

If sentiment is consistently positive over 7+ days, apply 0.5–1.0% downward bias to late horizon to prevent over-optimism.

If true price deviates >2.0% from 30-day moving average, adjust forecast by ±1.0% based on sentiment direction: + if sentiment >0.7, – if sentiment <0.3.
